The Router appropriately marked sagittal crests and neck manes as not present due to image quality/angles. Bilateral symmetry and fusiform body correctly marked present. Overall, the Router avoided evaluating 3 checkpoints by marking them untestable when they could have been judged as absent or partially present.

The Router significantly underestimated artifact severity, particularly the anatomical structural issues revealed by the pose auditor's evidence.
